section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study (Study X) with 135 female undergraduate students recruited from a university in Greater London, United Kingdom. Participants ranged in age from 17 to 51 years (M = 23.74) with self-reported BMI ranging from 17.15 to 33.27 kg/m² (M = 22.15). The sample was ethnically diverse, with 45.2% of European Caucasian descent, 23.7% Asian, 11.9% African Caribbean, and 19.3% other ancestry.
